entries.mrst_behavior: addTracerObserved references undefined W and reads tracerNames after defining tracNames, so the tracer path fails before producing observations.
entries.prst_action: Report, use schedule W and one canonical tracer-name variable, then test valid tracer, missing wells, well order and multiple files.

entries.mrst_behavior: Tracer, profile and saturation writers assign wellsol while all readers and the base observed structure use wellSol; MATLAB field names are case-sensitive.
entries.prst_action: Use one canonical wellSol-equivalent field and regression-test all three data types.

entries.mrst_behavior: Absolute permeability limits are converted from millidarcy in the absolute branch and converted a second time in the common permeability-scaling branch.
entries.prst_action: Apply exactly one millidarcy-to-SI conversion and test absolute PERMX/PERMY/PERMZ limits.

entries.mrst_behavior: A non-numeric objective weight becomes NaN through str2double; isempty(NaN) is false, so NaN enters the objective.
entries.prst_action: Reject non-finite weight input with a visible validation error; do not silently coerce it to zero.

entries.mrst_behavior: omega.wp is mutated inside the timestep loop. A low observed BHP can therefore suppress the same well's BHP mismatch in later timesteps.
entries.prst_action: Build a timestep-local BHP weight mask without mutating the input or later timesteps.

entries.mrst_behavior: The tracer cell-to-well sparse map uses p2w as matrix values instead of ones, multiplying concentrations by the one-based well number.
entries.prst_action: Use unit sparse aggregation weights and independently convert p2w row indices to zero-based Python indices.

entries.mrst_behavior: Profile and saturation loops compute a unique time but index observed with the full data-date vector instead of the current unique time.
entries.prst_action: Map each unique observation date to exactly one schedule timestep and test multiple dates.

entries.mrst_behavior: modelSetUpCheck only changes monitoring flags from false to true. Once a monitoring source has been valid, unchecking it or invalidating its file leaves the old true flag latched and Proceed can remain enabled without current monitoring data.
entries.prst_action: Recompute every starting-model, simulator and monitoring predicate from current widget state on each event; never retain a prior true value.
entries.state: reported; fixed in PRST with current-state recomputation

entries.mrst_behavior: CreatProjectButtonPushed discards system(command)'s exit status and immediately reads INIT, EGRID and UNRST. A failed simulator or a zero-exit run with no output therefore fails later in a reader without command diagnostics.
entries.prst_action: Retain the return code for diagnostics but preserve FAHM's output-based success rule: continue when all three required files exist, and otherwise raise a visible Create Project error listing the missing files without unlocking setup navigation.
entries.state: reported; fixed in PRST with output validation and diagnostics

entries.mrst_behavior: CreatProjectButtonPushed concatenates simulator and baseCase paths into a shell command without quoting. A selected tNavigator path or model directory containing spaces is split into multiple command arguments.
entries.prst_action: Build logical argv as individual tokens and launch binaries directly; for a Windows batch wrapper, serialize those tokens once with subprocess.list2cmdline. Test simulator, model and cwd paths containing spaces.
entries.state: reported; fixed in PRST with structured argv

entries.mrst_behavior: imposeCapPressScaling reads map.kw although getPcScalerMap creates map.pc, and its invalid-keyword branch calls warnProblem(prob) with undefined prob. Updating an existing pcscale or reporting an unsupported key therefore errors before applying the requested change.
entries.prst_action: Use the defined capillary mapping, pass the actual rejected keyword names to the warning path, and regression-test first creation plus subsequent in-place endpoint updates.
entries.state: reported; fixed in PRST with the defined pc mapping and explicit rejected-key warnings

entries.mrst_behavior: startupFcn blocks for 20 seconds with pause(20) before showing MainTabGroup.
entries.prst_action: Use a non-blocking two-second Tk after callback, as explicitly requested by the user; preserve the same before/after visibility states.
PRST Terminate behavior may be retained and tested separately from parity.

entries.mrst_behavior: Mismatch only switches empty view panels; result loading/population is not implemented.
entries.prst_action: PRST mismatch result loading and plots may be retained and tested separately from parity.
PRST View functionality may be retained and tested separately from parity.

policy: All unlisted effective FAHM behavior defaults to PARITY. Confirmed MRST defects are reported and fixed only in PRST; MRST source remains untouched.
